verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B300 is GPU server hardware (DGX/HGX systems running DGX OS), not an agent or AI application that could act as an MCP client. Plugging in MCP servers for tool use is a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
